comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight cap, remove its battery, and sort the parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, threaded disassembly, tipping an internal cell, and careful placement.
comparison.success_condition: Cap turned at least 300° and set down, battery in bin, flashlight outside bin, all released and still for 1 s; forced thread removal or loss zeros.
comparison.reason: Tests threaded disassembly and extraction of one captive component, not sieve-mediated many-body separation.
